release.exact_commit_record: RELEASE_MANIFEST.json.git_commit in the downloadable archive; also release.json.git_commit

validation.release_gate: The tagged source must pass offline, native PHP and archive verification before release publication
coverage: Complete source inventory and archive identity

recorded_local_acceptance.runtime: PHP 8.4.27 with -n; Python runtime and source-file hashes recorded in the log
recorded_local_acceptance.scope: Recorded computational acceptance; the version-tag workflow identifies checks of the final release tree

pre_release_hosted_evidence.scope: Earlier immutable pre-release snapshot, including the Windows archive-fixture correction

validation.native_test_contract: Eight native-dependent tests skip without an explicit PHP executable and pinned source; a skipped run does not establish fresh native execution
validation.online_checks: Recorded explorer anchors are compared offline. The offline command performs no fresh explorer query or historical receiving-clock reconstruction.

fixed_sample_interval_diagnostic.eligibility: Original legacy selection and eligibility retained

core_results.definitions: Below-300 counts include negatives; each calculation has its own selected denominator. The published interval is C-minus-A; corrected intervals are C-minus-B.

scope.classification: Published labels are fixed inputs; this audit does not independently validate attribution or identify Satoshi
scope.causal_interpretation: Descriptive header-time and nonce comparisons do not establish a mining pause or clock mechanism
scope.other_classification_sources: Alternative Bitquery label sets and their classifier are outside this release analysis
scope.review: Computational cross-checks are not an external human peer-review endorsement
scope.priority: The documented bounded search does not establish worldwide priority

history_policy: Dated observations and raw command logs are preserved for their tested snapshots; they are not rewritten as release results
